vault.setupBody: Set a device passphrase. Receipts on this PC stay encrypted until someone types it after a shutdown. Staff PINs are not this password.
vault.setupHint: Use at least 12 characters. Do not use only numbers.
vault.recoveryBody: If this PC is replaced or the Windows/Mac login is reset, this key is the only way to open receipts. Keep it off this PC — a phone photo or a paper in a safe.
vault.wroteItDown: I stored this recovery key somewhere that is not this computer
vault.unlockBody: Enter the same device passphrase you set when you encrypted this till. Typing a new code here does not create one.
vault.unlockRecoveryBody: Enter the recovery key shown when this till was encrypted. A new passphrase cannot be set while the till is locked.
vault.brokenBody: The encrypted database is here but the vault file is missing. Restore vault.json from a backup, or this copy of the receipts cannot be opened.

errors.digits_only: Do not use only numbers. Staff PINs cannot protect the till.
errors.mismatch: The two passphrases do not match.
errors.wrong_secret: That passphrase or recovery key is not correct.
errors.no_passphrase: This till has no device passphrase. Use the recovery key.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.os_unavailable: This computer cannot store the till key in Windows or Mac.
errors.locked: Unlock the till before changing this setting.
errors.unlock_failed: Could not encrypt this till. Close OneTap and try the same passphrase again.
errors.generic: Could not open the till. Try again.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.currencyInvalid: Currency must be a 3-letter ISO code (e.g. EUR, QAR, USD).
preferences.noShowGrace: No-show grace must be at least 5 minutes.
preferences.currencyHelp: Currency used across the POS (tickets, reports, receipts). Use a 3-letter ISO code like EUR, QAR, USD.
preferences.eurExchangeRateHelp: ALL per 1 EUR (e.g. 100.5). Shown on paid tickets and used for fiskalizimi when the POS currency is EUR.
preferences.eurExchangeRateInvalid: EUR exchange rate must be a positive number (e.g. 100.5).
preferences.languagesHelp: Default UI language for this venue. Applies to waiter, admin, and reservations screens.
preferences.languagesHelpStore: Default UI language for this till. Applies to staff and admin screens.
preferences.appearanceHelp: Light or dark screens for this venue. Applies to waiter, admin, and login.
preferences.appearanceHelpStore: Light or dark screens for this till. Applies to staff, admin, and login.
preferences.approvalsHelp: Require an ADMIN PIN to approve sensitive actions on waiter terminals.
preferences.approvalsHelpStore: Require an ADMIN PIN to approve sensitive actions on the till.
preferences.requirePinDiscountHelp: Any discount at payment requires approval.
preferences.requirePinService: Require manager PIN to remove service charge
preferences.requirePinServiceHelp: Removing service charge on a ticket requires approval.
preferences.captureClockHelp: Record when waiters start and end their shift. Turn this off if the venue does not need time tracking — staff can log in without clocking in.
preferences.captureClockHelpStore: Record when staff start and end their shift. Turn this off if the till does not need time tracking — staff can log in without clocking in.
preferences.captureClockEnableHelp: When off, login no longer starts a shift and the clock-out button is hidden.
preferences.blockShiftReopenEnableHelp: After a waiter clocks out, they cannot clock in again until the cooldown below ends.
preferences.blockShiftReopenEnableHelpStore: After staff clock out, they cannot clock in again until the cooldown below ends.
preferences.blockShiftReopenHoursHelp: How long after clock-out before the same person can start a new shift.
preferences.autoCloseHelp: Automatically close a waiter's shift if it stays open for too long. Shifts are only auto-closed when the waiter has no open tickets — open tickets always block the auto-close.
preferences.autoCloseHelpStore: Automatically close a staff shift if it stays open for too long. Shifts are only auto-closed when there is no open sale.
preferences.autoCloseEnableHelp: Runs in the background every 15 minutes.
preferences.autoNoShowHelp: Automatically mark a BOOKED reservation as NO SHOW after a grace period past its start time. Frees the table on the reservation floor while keeping the record on the List view. Only affects reservations that haven't been seated, cancelled or completed.
preferences.autoNoShowEnableHelp: Runs in the background every minute.
preferences.serviceChargeHelp: Adds an automatic service charge to the bill. Waiters can remove it per ticket.

settingsUpdates.helpStore: One action updates this Admin app, the POS till it is connected to (including a till on another computer), and kitchen displays on the same network — only where a newer version is available.
settingsUpdates.installConfirm: POS, kitchen displays, and this Admin app will restart if they have an update. Continue?
settingsUpdates.kdsHint: Online kitchen screens check and install when you download or install.

settingsBilling.notRequired: Billing is not required in this development session.

settingsVault.title: Till disk protection
settingsVault.help: Receipts on the restaurant PC stay encrypted on disk. Staff still log in with their PIN. Choose whether OneTap can open by itself after Windows or Mac login, or must ask for a passphrase after every restart.
settingsVault.autoHelp: Uses this computer’s Windows or Mac login. OneTap will not ask for a passphrase when it starts. Someone who copies the disk still cannot read receipts.
settingsVault.passphraseTitle: Ask for a passphrase when OneTap starts
settingsVault.passphraseHelp: Use this only if you want the till locked even after Windows is logged in. You will type a device passphrase each time the app starts.
settingsVault.statusOff: Disk protection is off on this till (development builds stay plaintext unless POS_VAULT=1).
settingsVault.statusLocked: The till is locked. Unlock it on the restaurant PC first.
settingsVault.statusBroken: This till cannot be unlocked. Restore vault.json from a backup.
settingsVault.statusOs: Receipts are encrypted. The till opens with this PC’s Windows or Mac login.
settingsVault.statusPassphrase: Receipts are encrypted. OneTap asks for the device passphrase after a restart.
settingsVault.osUnavailable: This computer cannot store the till key in Windows or Mac. Set a passphrase instead.
settingsVault.failed: Could not save the till unlock setting.
settingsVault.eraseHelp: Permanently deletes every kitchen ticket, paid sale, and open table on this till. Menu, staff, and settings are kept. This cannot be undone.
settingsVault.eraseConfirmBody: This deletes all tickets, paid receipts, kitchen orders, and occupied tables. Type {{phrase}} to confirm.
settingsVault.eraseLocked: Unlock the till on the restaurant PC first.

settingsAreas.nameFirst: Name the area first, before editing the layout.
settingsAreas.layoutHint: Place tables on the dashed dining room — they snap to a block grid so edges line up. Use Preview floor to see the waiter view, then Save layout or Done.

settingsPrinter.noRoutes: No routings yet. Press + to create one.
settingsPrinter.unknownKey: Unknown key stored in settings. You can remove it if not needed.

settingsPrinter.categoriesHelp: Select every category that should print together on one slip (e.g. all drink categories to the bar printer).

settingsFloor.emptyHint: Empty floor — use + Table and + Shape, then Save layout.

settingsFloor.alignTitle: Snap every piece to the block grid
settingsFloor.snapHint: Pieces snap in {{px}}px blocks. Preview is the waiter view. Arrow keys nudge.

settingsFloor.noLayoutYet: No layout yet — ask an admin to set up this area in Settings → Table Areas.

fiscal.title: Fiskalizimi
fiscal.enableHelp: When enabled, payment receipts are submitted to certified fiscal middleware before printing, and VAT is added on tickets and in admin statistics. When disabled, receipts print normally with no VAT on prices.
fiscal.middlewareHelp: Use the easyPos cloud URL from Postman, or a local desktop API URL.
fiscal.baseUrlRequired: Base URL is required when fiskalizimi is enabled.
fiscal.authTokenRequired: Access token is required when fiskalizimi is enabled.
fiscal.authTokenConfigured: Token saved — enter a new value to replace
fiscal.authTokenStored: Access token is saved on this device. Leave blank to keep it — to replace it, paste a fresh token from Postman and Save.
fiscal.tokenHint: Saved token ends …{{suffix}} · tokenId …{{tokenId}} · device …{{deviceTail}} — compare with Postman Variables.
fiscal.tokenResyncHelp: Article and unit must match your easyPos catalog.
fiscal.integrationAppRequired: Integration app ID is required for easyPos cloud API.
fiscal.operatorIdRequired: Operator code is required for easyPos cloud API.
fiscal.operatorIdTypo: Operator looks wrong: use gh537ez280 (from your verified invoice), not gh537ez200.
fiscal.operatorIdHelp: From Postman or the successful invoice JSON (operatorCode field).
fiscal.niptHelp: Your business tax number. The tax-site QR cannot open an invoice without it.
fiscal.defaultSoldInHelp: Must match Postman Register Invoice (Minimal) — for your demo account use XPP, not cope.
fiscal.cloudFallbackArticleIdHelp: Used only for lines with no menu SKU (service charge, discounts, uncoded items). Menu SKUs are never overwritten — they must match articles in the easyPos catalog.
fiscal.eurExchangeRateHelp: Required if POS currency is EUR (e.g. 100.5 ALL per 1 EUR).
fiscal.openingFloatHelp: Cash in the drawer at the start of the day. Declared to the tax service once a day, before the first cash sale — cash invoices are refused until it is. Leave at 0 if the till keeps no float.
fiscal.testMinimalNeedsToken: Paste the full accessToken from Postman Variables into Access token first, then click Test minimal invoice again. Leaving the field blank keeps the old saved token (…{{suffix}}), which does not match Postman.
fiscal.testMinimalUnavailable: Restart the POS app, then try again (fiscal test handler not loaded).
fiscal.testOkCloudAuth: Connected and authenticated. Token, URL, and integration app are correct. docId is generated automatically when you take a payment.
fiscal.testFailed: Could not connect to fiscal middleware.
fiscal.reviewHelp: Waiting to send: the till will transmit automatically (48-hour window). Unconfirmed or correction rows need someone to open easyPos, then say what you did.
fiscal.reviewDeferredHelp: The sale was taken while fiskalizimi was unreachable. The till will send this same invoice automatically. It must reach CIS within 48 hours.
fiscal.reviewDeferredOverdue: Past the 48-hour window — send via SelfCare if this does not clear.
fiscal.reviewCorrectionHelp: This sale was already declared to the tax service and then voided, so the invoice above no longer matches what happened. Issue a corrective invoice in easyPos, then mark it done.
fiscal.salesHelp: A filed invoice cannot be withdrawn — it is undone by a cancellation or corrective invoice referencing it. This records the reversal, takes it out of the reports, and lists the correction in Settings → Fiscalization for you to file in easyPos.
fiscal.salesMovedToTickets: To reverse a settled or fiscalized sale, open the ticket under Tickets and choose View more.
fiscal.salesOpenHelp: This ticket is still open. Fiscal identifiers and the reverse button appear after it is paid.
fiscal.salesNoOrder: No settled invoice is linked to this ticket.
fiscal.salesVerifyQr: Scan to check this invoice on the official tax website.
fiscal.salesVerifyNeedsNipt: Add your NIPT in Settings → Fiscalization so this invoice can open on the tax website.
fiscal.salesVerifyCancelQr: Scan the cancellation invoice — this is the void on the tax website.
fiscal.salesVerifyOriginalQr: Original invoice as first filed — the tax site still shows this as issued.
fiscal.salesVerifyCancelPending: The tax website still shows the original invoice as issued until the cancellation invoice is filed in easyPos.
fiscal.salesNotFiscalized: Not fiscalized — nothing to correct at the tax service.
fiscal.salesReasonHint: e.g. charged twice, guest never served
fiscal.salesCancelHelp: Withdraws the entire sale and removes it from the reports.
fiscal.salesCorrectiveHelp: Strikes the ticked lines and restates the total.
fiscal.salesUseCancel: That is every line — cancel the whole invoice instead.
fiscal.salesBadPin: Wrong manager PIN — nothing was changed.
fiscal.salesDoneNeedsFiling: Sale reversed. File the corrective invoice in easyPos, then confirm it in Settings → Fiscalization.
fiscal.reviewFoundHelp: The invoice exists. The sale will be recorded with these numbers and never sent again.
fiscal.reviewNotFoundHelp: No invoice exists. The payment will be sent again.

kdsSettings.title: Kitchen Display (KDS)
kdsSettings.masterHelp: Turn this off if the kitchen works from printed tickets only. Orders still print; nothing is sent to KDS screens.

kdsSettings.stationDisabled: {{station}} disabled — orders no longer route here.
kdsSettings.bumpHelp: Program each physical key in PrehKeyTec WinProgrammer (or MapMyKey) to send the keystroke below. USB plug-and-play — no driver needed on the KDS PC.

stockPanel.pageHelp: Set in-stock, low, or out-of-stock for each menu item.

stockPanel.costDescription: What you pay versus what you sell it for. Profit is sell price minus cost. Margin is profit as a share of the sell price.

adminLan.hostRunningTitle: Tablets stay connected in the background
adminLan.hostRunningTitleStore: Extra tills stay connected in the background
adminLan.hostRunningBody: On the installed POS, closing this window does not stop the app. It keeps running in the menu bar (Mac) or system tray (Windows) so iPads and tablets can still take orders. Open it again from that icon. Choose Quit on the icon to stop — tablets will disconnect until the POS is opened on this computer.
adminLan.hostRunningBodyStore: On the installed POS, closing this window does not stop the app. It keeps running in the menu bar (Mac) or system tray (Windows) so extra tills and tablets can still take sales. Open it again from that icon. Choose Quit on the icon to stop — extra tills will disconnect until the POS is opened on this computer.
adminLan.openAtLogin: Start automatically when this computer starts
adminLan.openAtLoginHint: Opens in the background at sign-in so tablets work even if nobody opens the till screen. Turn this off if you do not want the POS to launch by itself.
adminLan.openAtLoginHintStore: Opens in the background at sign-in so extra tills work even if nobody opens the till screen. Turn this off if you do not want the POS to launch by itself.
adminLan.title: LAN / Tablets
adminLan.allowBrowserHelp: Lets waiters open the POS from a browser on the same network (tablet/phone web browsers, laptops). The installed POS app on iOS/Android always works regardless of this toggle. Takes effect immediately after saving — already-connected browsers will lose access on their next request.
adminLan.allowBrowserHelpStore: Lets cashiers open the POS from a browser on the same network (tablet/phone web browsers, laptops). The installed POS app on iOS/Android always works regardless of this toggle. Takes effect immediately after saving — already-connected browsers will lose access on their next request.
adminLan.requirePairingHelp: Tablet / phone logins (browser and native app) must enter the pairing code shown below.
adminLan.browserDisabled: Browser access is disabled. The desktop app and the installed iOS / Android POS app can still connect. Enable “Allow browser access” above to let waiters open the POS from a regular web browser too.
adminLan.browserDisabledStore: Browser access is disabled. The desktop app and the installed iOS / Android POS app can still connect. Enable “Allow browser access” above to let cashiers open the POS from a regular web browser too.
adminLan.pairingHint: Use this code on tablets when logging in.
adminLan.pairingHintStore: Use this code on extra tills or tablets when logging in.
adminLan.setupHint: Use this on each tablet once. It saves this venue's IP, ports, and pairing code in the browser so staff don't re-enter them after restarting the POS or reopening the app (same device & browser).
adminLan.setupHintStore: Use this on each extra till or tablet once. It saves this shop's IP, ports, and pairing code in the browser so staff don't re-enter them after restarting the POS or reopening the app (same device & browser).
adminLan.noWifi: No Wi‑Fi IP detected. Connect this Mac to Wi‑Fi or Ethernet and reopen this page.
